title: SSC CGL 2026 - CT 01: Alphabet or Word Test - Dictionary Order

questions.question: Select the option that represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in an English dictionary. 1. Amphibian 2. Ambiguous 3. Ambience 4. Amplify 5. Amorphous 6. Ambivalent 7. Ameliorate
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that represents the correct order of the given words as they would appear in an English dictionary.

1. Amphibian

2. Ambiguous

3. Ambience

4. Amplify

5. Amorphous

6. Ambivalent

7. Ameliorate
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The given words are arranged according to the English dictionary order.

3. Ambience

2. Ambiguous

6. Ambivalent

7. Ameliorate

5. Amorphous

1. Amphibian

4. Amplify

Hence, the correct answer is "3, 2, 6, 7, 5, 1, 4".

questions.question: Arrange are following words as per order in the dictionary 1) Euphoria 2) Happiness 3) Ambivalence 4) Ecstasy 5) Pleasure
questions.questionHtml:
Arrange are following words as per order in the dictionary

1) Euphoria

2) Happiness

3) Ambivalence

4) Ecstasy

5) Pleasure
questions.solution:
The correct Dictionary order is:

3. Ambivalence

4. Ecstasy

1. Euphoria

2. Happiness

5. Pleasure

So, the correct order is: '3, 4, 1, 2, 5'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
